name: Pomegranate
siboNotes: Pomegranate is well-tolerated and may have anti-inflammatory properties beneficial for gut health. The fiber content is moderate and typically well-handled during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Remove arils underwater to prevent staining and make separation easier
Store fresh arils in refrigerator for up to 5 days
Frozen arils work well in smoothies and maintain nutritional value
Pat arils dry before adding to salads to prevent excess moisture
nutritionalHighlights: High in antioxidants and vitamin C
Rich in polyphenols with anti-inflammatory properties
